description: Inert reusable pure numeric function mapping. Exact required root fields below; no executable extensions.

matcher.body: Expression tree. A function has one return or expression arrow, numeric parameters, no effects, captures, defaults, rest, types or async.

expression.types: arithmetic and comparisons take numbers; boolean operations take booleans; select takes boolean then equal-typed alternatives

preconditions.constantParameters: array of unique parameter indices required to be compile-time constants
preconditions.predicates: array of boolean expression trees over parameters

lowering: An expression tree of the same result type as matcher.body. Identical lowering is permitted; validation establishes exact bounded semantics.
capabilities: Exactly the sorted distinct operation names used in lowering, prefixed integer- for numeric results and boolean- for boolean results, e.g. integer-add and integer-min. Leaves have no capability.

provenance.liveDiscovery: boolean (a claim, independently recorded invocation required)

tests.negative: array of {args:[values],reason:optional string} violating numeric domain or predicates

validation: Compiler-owned JavaScript oracle, structural/numeric corpus, exact reachable application closure. Proposal tests supplemental. Candidate <=64KiB. Max64 tests in each list. No naming/path assumptions.
